observations.body: Zedekiah rebels, Babylon besieges Jerusalem, famine intensifies, the king is captured, sons are killed, eyes are put out, Temple and city are burned, and people are exiled.
observations.label: Judah falls and Jerusalem is emptied: action

payload.posture: Read 2 Kings 24:18–25:21 as one people becomes two kingdoms evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The final kingdom associated with Israel’s story loses king, city, Temple, land, and freedom, yet the narrative continues beyond this ending.
